96:         size_t start = text.find("{{", pos);

98:             rendered.append(text.substr(pos));

102:         size_t end = text.find("}}", start + 2);
103:         if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
104:             rendered.append(text.substr(pos));
105:             break;
106:         }

109:         std::string_view placeholder = text.substr(start, end + 2 - start);
110:         bool replaced = false;
111:         for (const auto& [from, to] : replacements) {
112:             if (placeholder == from) {
